control.level.agents.note: The control level Control agents (Settings → Assistant → Control), as the Assistant's refusals name it.

control.level.look.note: The control level Look and advise (Settings → Assistant → Control), as the Assistant's refusals name it.

control.level.projects.note: The control level Control agents and create projects (Settings → Assistant → Control), as the Assistant's refusals name it.

control.notAllowed.text: not allowed by Settings → Assistant → Control
control.notAllowed.note: Why a change was refused, in the Assistant's activity list beside the change (#763).

control.notAllowedReason.text: Not allowed by Settings → Assistant → Control
control.notAllowedReason.note: Why a change was refused, as the Agent API's event stream says it (a refusal's reason, #763).

control.refused.text: The user's settings (Settings → Assistant → Control: {level}) don't let you {what}. Tell the user what you would do instead.
control.refused.note: The Assistant's change refused by its control level (#186). {level} is the level's name (control.level.*); {what} what the change is called, lower case ("create a card").

control.sessionEnded.text: The Assistant's session that asked for this ended before the change was made: nothing changed here.
control.sessionEnded.note: The Assistant's change refused at the moment it was to be made: the session that asked was restarted or ended while it waited.

control.tokenNote.text: The Hive Assistant's Agent API token for one workspace. Hive replaces it each time the Assistant starts.
control.tokenNote.note: The note beside the Assistant's token in its file, for whoever opens it.

control.turnedDown.text: The user turned Settings → Assistant → Control down before this change was made: nothing changed here.
control.turnedDown.note: The Assistant's change refused at the moment it was to be made: the control level was lowered while it waited.
